source_of_truth: This file is the blueprint. The HTML graphs are rendered FROM it (tools/gen.mjs), the clone's dependency-rules gate is DERIVED from it (verify.rules), and future workorder tasks cite node ids from it. Edit this file, regenerate; never edit the HTML.

meta.subtitle: The build follows this graph: solid arrows are the ONLY imports allowed (deny-by-default, enforced by verify.rules), dashed arrows are data flows, pills are build phase · parallel track. Filter by phase to watch the four disjoint P1 tracks appear — that disjointness is the parallel-work plan.

bands.name: Contracts
bands.desc: Versioned artifact schemas + exactly one codec per artifact. The seams of the old system, promoted to first-class citizens with round-trip tests.

bands.name: Engine
bands.desc: Pure intelligence: parse, extract, resolve, graph, analytics, RAG. No filesystem access outside the loader and codecs. No presentation, no process artifacts.

bands.name: Transports
bands.desc: Zero-logic adapters over one typed facade: MCP server, CLI bins, watch/SSE daemon. Parity between them is by construction, not by parity tests.

bands.name: Surfaces
bands.desc: Consumers: map viewer, doc generator, context packer. They import contracts only — they must run against fixture artifacts with no engine present.

bands.name: Verification
bands.desc: The instruments that make the clone unable to lie to itself: frozen fixture, A/B parity vs today's CODEREF-CORE, blueprint-derived rules gate, map-vs-blueprint drift.

bands.name: External
bands.desc: Ghosts outside the build: AI agents and IDEs, CI, humans, and today's CODEREF-CORE as the parity baseline.

problems.title: Seam disagreement — two components, no seam test
Duplicated surfaces kept in parity by hand

nodes.name: RepoPath
nodes.responsibility: Branded repo-relative POSIX path type. Construction and normalization happen only at boundaries (loader, codecs, adapters); raw path strings die on entry. Windows-first test matrix.

nodes.name: Index schema
nodes.responsibility: File + element records: identity (@Type/file#name:line), spans, exports, docstrings. The artifact every downstream reader joins on.

nodes.name: Graph schema
nodes.responsibility: Node/edge kinds, resolution provenance enum, confidence tiers, evidence blocks. One vocabulary for every edge the system will ever emit — a new edge kind is a schema change here, and every reader learns it at compile time.

nodes.name: Map schema
nodes.responsibility: MapData projection: dir/file nodes, aggregated edges, overlays, analytics blocks. Exactly what surface.viewer renders — versioned so viewer and engine can never silently disagree.

nodes.name: Header codec
nodes.responsibility: Semantic-header grammar with generator and parser as ONE co-located codec, round-trip property-tested: parse(generate(x)) === x for all x. The hash-asymmetry class dies here.

nodes.name: RAG schema
nodes.responsibility: Chunk records, embedding metadata, scoring envelope. Joins to contracts.index by element id — never by header presence.

nodes.name: Staleness envelope
nodes.responsibility: Provenance + staleness block REQUIRED on every artifact and every query response. Readers must distinguish empty (measured zero) from absent (no data). Vector-vs-index and source-vs-graph axes both stamped.

nodes.name: Source loader
nodes.responsibility: Owns scan scope: allowlist-first discovery (source globs in; build output, planning trees, and generated artifacts out by construction, not by ignore-file discipline). The only module that walks the filesystem.

nodes.name: Parser registry
nodes.responsibility: Grammar registry + per-language adapters (TS/JS first, then Python/Go/…) producing exactly one AST session per file per run.

nodes.name: Extractors
nodes.responsibility: Single-walk extraction: elements, raw call/reference sites, and docstrings ride ONE traversal. An extractor that sees frames the others skip (the arrow-function class) is structurally impossible — there is only one walk.

nodes.name: Symbol table
nodes.responsibility: Symbol table + scope stack: bindings, heritage, receiver typing. Feeds resolution; owned by exactly one writer.

nodes.name: Resolver
nodes.responsibility: Import-origin classification and call-resolution tiering. Every edge is stamped with provenance and confidence from contracts.graph — an unstamped edge cannot be constructed.

nodes.name: Graph builder
nodes.responsibility: Builds the canonical graph and owns THE single adjacency index. Every query path — MCP, CLI, analytics, surfaces — reads this one structure.

nodes.name: Enrichment
nodes.responsibility: Framework, route, and middleware detection; @Endpoint and @Doc as first-class graph nodes; doc-code ties.

nodes.name: Analytics
nodes.responsibility: Cycles, hotspots, impact BFS, path search, clones, ast-metrics, and the map projection (emits contracts.map artifacts) — pure functions over the one graph.

nodes.name: Measurement
nodes.responsibility: Owns every published number: denominators, unresolved taxonomy, exclusions applied at the source (never left to ignore files). No consumer computes its own counts.

nodes.name: RAG engine
nodes.responsibility: Chunking, embedder port (local Ollama adapter), BM25 sub-token index, RRF fusion. Consumes contracts.index; fully functional on repos with zero headers.

nodes.name: Header enrichment
nodes.responsibility: Emits and refreshes semantic headers exclusively through the contracts.headers codec. Optional everywhere — nothing downstream requires headers to exist.

nodes.name: Watch core
nodes.responsibility: Pure incremental invalidation: file delta in, minimal re-scan set + graph patch out. No filesystem watching here — that lives in the transport.

nodes.name: Mutation
nodes.responsibility: AST-guarded rename/refactor: impact-aware preview plans and atomic apply. The single sanctioned source-writer in the system (carries the GX-003 scoped-write posture forward).

nodes.name: Engine API
nodes.responsibility: THE typed facade. Every query and command the system offers is a function here; transports may import nothing else. MCP/CLI parity is by construction — there is no second implementation to drift.

nodes.name: MCP server
nodes.responsibility: Tool schema in, engine.api call, envelope out. Zero query logic; size-budgeted handlers so logic physically cannot accrete here.

nodes.name: CLI bins
nodes.responsibility: The same engine.api functions behind argv. ONE build config shared with the engine — the stale-dist trap has nowhere to live.

nodes.name: Watch daemon
nodes.responsibility: Filesystem events in, engine.watchcore via engine.api, SSE delta feed out to editors and agents.

nodes.name: Map viewer
nodes.responsibility: Interactive map web app. Reads MapData artifacts (contracts.map) and nothing else — it must render a fixture artifact with no engine installed.

nodes.name: Doc generator
nodes.responsibility: Resource sheets, foundation docs, READMEs generated from index + graph artifacts. Lives outside the engine so doc churn never dirties the scan loop.

nodes.name: Context packer
nodes.responsibility: Token-budgeted context packs and change dossiers assembled from index, graph, and RAG artifacts.

nodes.name: Frozen fixture
nodes.responsibility: Hand-verified mini-repos per language with pinned truth: exact element and edge counts, known cycles, known unresolved calls. Every track builds against it; a count drift is a red build, not a surprise.

nodes.name: Rules gate
nodes.responsibility: Dependency rules DERIVED from this blueprint.json. The clone scans itself with its own CLI; an import edge not present in this graph fails CI, and the intra-engine cycle count is pinned at zero from the first commit.

nodes.name: Parity harness
nodes.responsibility: A/B: clone vs today's CODEREF-CORE over the fixture and live repos. Every count difference is adjudicated improvement-or-bug in writing before any cutover.

nodes.name: Drift check
nodes.responsibility: The clone's own map, diffed against this blueprint. As-built converges on as-designed visibly, every build.

nodes.name: AI agents & IDEs
nodes.responsibility: Claude, Cursor, VS Code — consume MCP tools and SSE deltas.

nodes.name: CI / CD
nodes.responsibility: Pre-flight gates and audits via CLI JSON streams.

nodes.name: Humans
nodes.responsibility: Browse the map, read the docs.

nodes.name: CODEREF-CORE
nodes.responsibility: The parity baseline during the build. Retired at cutover — not carried as a legacy door (L10).

laws.text: One codec per artifact: every artifact is read and written only through its contracts codec, and every codec ships a round-trip property test.
Single parse: one AST session per file per run; every extractor rides the same walk.
One adjacency index: exactly one graph store; every query surface reads it.
Zero-logic adapters: transports import engine.api and nothing else; handler bodies are schema-map + call, size-budgeted in CI.
Deny-by-default imports: an import edge not present in blueprint.json fails verify.rules in CI.
Branded paths: repo-relative POSIX RepoPath at every boundary; raw path strings die at the loader. Windows is a first-class CI target.
Honest numbers: denominators and exclusions are owned by engine.measure; every artifact and response carries the staleness envelope; readers distinguish empty from unknown.
Engine-repo purity: no planning trees, no process machinery, no generated output inside scan scope — allowlist discovery makes pollution structurally impossible.
Cycles pinned at zero inside the engine from the first commit.
Delete, don't quarantine: superseded code is removed in the same phase its replacement proves parity. No legacy doors.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.content: Pin the seams before any behavior: all seven contracts (schemas + codecs + round-trip tests), the frozen fixture with hand-verified truth, and the rules-gate scaffold that derives dependency rules from this blueprint.
phases.exit: Schemas versioned and frozen; every codec round-trips on fixture data; rules gate demonstrably turns red on a forbidden import and green on the allowed set.

phases.name: Parallel build
phases.content: Four tracks with no shared edges except the frozen contracts: A engine core chain (loader→parser→extract→symbols→resolve→graph), B engine.api signature + MCP/CLI shells against fixture artifacts, C surfaces against fixture artifacts, D RAG against the index contract + local Ollama.
phases.exit: Each track green on the fixture in isolation; the phase filter on the blueprint shows four disjoint subtrees — that disjointness is the parallelism claim, and verify.rules enforces it.

phases.name: Integration & instruments
phases.content: Enrichment, analytics, measurement, watch; bind engine.api to the real engine; stand up verify.parity (clone vs CODEREF-CORE) and verify.drift (map vs blueprint).
phases.exit: Parity report exists and every count difference is adjudicated improvement-or-bug in writing; drift check clean; cycles zero; rules gate green.

phases.name: Cutover
phases.content: Per-surface adoption behind parity proof — MCP consumers first, then CLI/CI, then viewer/doc-gen/pack. Superseded paths deleted in the same phase (L10).
phases.exit: Consumers run on the clone; ext.reference retired; nothing survives behind a legacy door.
